a YA novel in a silkpunk fantasy setting
humans live in the physical realm, with a magical realm some are more attuned to
those with strong resonance are called "resonant"
resonant people can draw upon magic and transform it into spells in the physical realm
second law of resonance: all magic tends towards chaos
each spell costs a fraction of the caster's life force
spell cost scales with caster's power and spell's power
Reilang is a shadow of a former empire that once ruled the world
former empire was most powerful during the golden age of magic
former empire collapsed when the most powerful mage families went to war vying to rule the world
most details of the former empire's history have been lost or mythologized
